label: Subsection
text: Flashing at Intersections

label: Article
text: Required Flashing at Intersections

label: Sentence
text: Except where the omission of flashing will not adversely affect adjacent supported or supporting constructions, flashing shall be installed at junctions between roofs and

label: Clause
title: a)
text: walls that rise above the roof, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: guards that are connected to the roof by more than pickets or posts.

label: Sentence
text: For the purpose of Sentence (1), roofs shall include platforms that effectively serve as roofs with respect to the accumulation or drainage of precipitation.

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Sheet metal flashing shall consist of not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 1.73 mm thick sheet lead,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 0.33 mm thick galvanized steel,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 0.33 mm thick copper,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: 0.35 mm thick zinc, or

label: Clause
title: e)
text: 0.48 mm thick aluminum.

label: Article
text: Valley Flashing

label: Sentence
text: Where sloping surfaces of shingled roofs intersect to form a valley, the valley shall be flashed.

label: Sentence
text: Valley flashing shall be installed over continuous sheathing.

label: Sentence
text: Closed valleys shall not be used with rigid shingles on slopes of less than 1 in 1.2.

label: Sentence
text: Open valleys shall be flashed with at least

label: Clause
title: a)
text: one layer of sheet metal not less than 600 mm wide, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 2 layers of roll roofing.

label: Sentence
text: The bottom layer of roofing required in Sentence (4) shall consist of at least Type S smooth roll roofing or Type M mineral surface roll roofing (mineral surface down) not less than 457 mm wide, centred in the valley and fastened with nails spaced not more than 450 mm o.c. located 25 mm away from the edges.

label: Sentence
text: The top layer of roofing required in Sentence (4) shall consist of at least Type M mineral surface roll roofing (mineral surface up), 914 mm wide, centred in the valley, applied over a 100 mm wide strip of cement along each edge of the bottom layer, and fastened with a sufficient number of nails to hold it in place until the shingles are applied.

label: Article
text: Intersection of Shingle Roofs and Masonry

label: Sentence
text: The intersection of shingle roofs and masonry walls or chimneys shall be protected with flashing.

label: Sentence
text: Counter flashing required in Sentence (1) shall be embedded not less than 25 mm in the masonry and shall extend not less than 150 mm down the masonry and lap the lower flashing not less than 100 mm.

label: Sentence
text: Flashing along the slopes of a roof described in Sentence (1) shall be stepped so that there is not less than a 75 mm head lap in both the lower flashing and counter flashing.

label: Sentence
text: Where the roof described in Sentence (1) slopes upwards from the masonry, the flashing shall extend up the roof slope to a point equal in height to the flashing on the masonry, but not less than 1.5 times the shingle exposure.

label: Article
text: Intersection of Shingle Roofs and Walls other than Masonry

label: Sentence
text: The intersection of shingle roofs and walls clad with other than masonry shall be protected with flashing.

label: Sentence
text: Flashing required in Sentence (1) shall be installed so that it extends up the wall not less than 75 mm behind the sheathing paper, and extends not less than 75 mm horizontally.

label: Sentence
text: Along the slope of the roof, the flashing required in Sentence (1) shall be stepped with not less than a 75 mm head lap.

label: Article
text: Intersection of Built-Up Roofs and Masonry

label: Sentence
text: The intersection of built-up roofs with masonry walls or chimneys shall have a cant strip at the intersection, and a roofing membrane shall be mopped over the cant strip and not less than 150 mm up the wall.

label: Sentence
text: Counter flashing installed over the intersection referred to in Sentence (1) shall be embedded not less than 25 mm in the masonry, and shall be of sufficient length to extend down not less than 150 mm, lapping the membrane on the masonry not less than 100 mm.

label: Article
text: Intersection of Built-Up Roofs and Walls other than Masonry

label: Sentence
text: The intersection of built-up roofs with walls clad with other than masonry shall have a cant strip at the intersection.

label: Sentence
text: The roofing membrane shall be mopped over the cant strip referred to in Sentence (1).

label: Sentence
text: Flashing plies shall extend not less than 150 mm up the wall referred to in Sentence (1) behind the sheathing paper.

label: Article
text: Chimney Saddles

label: Sentence
text: Except as otherwise permitted in Sentence (5), chimney saddles shall be installed where the upper side of a chimney on a sloping roof is more than 750 mm wide.

references.link_text: Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.
Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.

label: Sentence
text: Chimney saddles shall be covered with sheet metal or roofing material of weight and quality equivalent to the roofing.

references.link_text: Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.

label: Sentence
text: Saddles shall be flashed where they intersect the roof.

label: Sentence
text: The intersection of the saddle and the chimney shall be flashed and counterflashed as described in Article 9.26.4.4.

references.link_text: Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.

label: Sentence
text: A chimney saddle need not be installed if the intersection between the chimney and roof is protected by sheet metal flashing that extends up the chimney to a height equal to at least one sixth the width of the chimney , but not less than 150 mm, and up the roof slope to a point equal in height to the flashing on the chimney , but not less than 1.5 times the shingle exposure.

references.link_text: Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.
Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.
Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.
Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.
Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.

label: Sentence
text: Flashing described in Sentence (5) at the chimney shall be counterflashed as required by Article 9.26.4.4.

references.link_text: Chimney means a primarily vertical shaft enclosing at least one flue for conducting flue gases to the outdoors.

label: Article
text: Roof Penetrations

label: Sentence
text: Where a pipe or duct penetrates a roof, the joint between the pipe or duct and the roof shall be flashed and be made watertight.

label: Sentence
text: Except as required by Sentence (3), flashing for a pipe or duct shall be rectangular and shall be not less than 500 mm in length by 500 mm in width and, if sleeve flashing is used, the sleeve shall extend not less than 150 mm above the roof at every point of the pipe or duct.

label: Sentence
text: The flashing flange for a pipe or duct shall extend

label: Clause
title: a)
text: not less than 125 mm beyond a pipe or duct penetrating a sloping roof, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: not less than 250 mm beyond a pipe or duct penetrating a flat roof.

label: Sentence
text: If lead sheet is used as a flashing for a plumbing system pipe, it shall be worked over and into a hub of the increaser, which shall then be fitted with a 100 mm diam or larger roof ring caulked into the hub of the increaser.

references.link_text: Plumbing system means a drainage system, a venting system and a water system or parts thereof.

label: Subsection
text: Eave Protection for Shingles and Shakes

label: Article
text: Required Eave Protection

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), eave protection shall be provided on shingle, shake or tile roofs, extending from the edge of the roof a minimum of 900 mm up the roof slope to a line not less than 300 mm inside the inner face of the exterior wall.

label: Sentence
text: Eave protection is not required

label: Clause
title: a)
text: over unheated garages, carports and porches,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: where the roof overhang exceeds 900 mm measured along the roof slope from the edge of the roof to the inner face of the exterior wall,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: on roofs of asphalt shingles installed in accordance with Subsection 9.26.8.,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: on roofs with slopes of 1 in 1.5 or greater, or

label: Clause
title: e)
text: in regions with 3 500 or fewer degree-days.

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Eave protection shall be laid beneath the starter strip and shall consist of

label: Clause
title: a)
text: No. 15 asphalt-saturated felt laid in two plies lapped 480 mm and cemented together with lap cement,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: Type M or S roll roofing laid with not less than 100 mm head and end laps cemented together with lap cement,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: glass fibre or polyester fibre coated base sheets, or

label: Clause
title: d)
text: self-sealing composite membranes consisting of modified bituminous coated material.

label: Subsection
text: Underlay beneath Shingles

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Except as required in Sentence (2), when underlay is used beneath shingles, it shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: asphalt-saturated sheathing paper weighing not less than 0.195 kg/m 2 , or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: No. 15 plain or perforated asphalt-saturated felt.

label: Sentence
text: Underlay used beneath wood shingles shall be breather type.

label: Article
text: Installation

label: Sentence
text: When used with shingles, underlay shall be installed parallel to the eaves with head and end lap of not less than 50 mm.

label: Sentence
text: The top edge of each strip of underlay referred to in Sentence (1) shall be fastened with sufficient roofing nails to hold it in place until the shingles are applied.

label: Sentence
text: The underlay referred to in Sentence (1) shall overlap the eave protection by not less than 100 mm. (See Article 9.26.10.2. for underlay beneath wood shakes.)

label: Subsection
text: Asphalt Shingles on Slopes of 1 in 3 or Greater

label: Article
text: Coverage

label: Sentence
text: Coverage shall be not less than 2 thicknesses of shingle over the entire roof, disregarding cutouts.

label: Article
text: Starter Strip

label: Sentence
text: A starter strip shall be installed along the lower edge of the roof so that it extends approximately 12 mm beyond the eaves and rake of the roof and fastened along the bottom edge with nails spaced not more than 300 mm o.c.

label: Sentence
text: Starter strips shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: at least Type M mineral-surfaced roll roofing not less than 300 mm wide,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: shingles of the same weight and quality as those used as a roof covering with tabs facing up the roof slope, or

label: Clause
title: c)
text: pre-manufactured starter strips installed with sealant at the eaves.

label: Sentence
text: Starter strips need not be provided where eave protection of not less than Type M mineral-surfaced roll roofing is provided.

label: Article
text: Head Lap

label: Sentence
text: Shingles shall have a head lap of not less than 50 mm.

label: Article
text: Fasteners

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), shingles shall be fastened with at least 4 nails or staples for 1 m wide shingles so that no nails or staples are exposed.

label: Sentence
text: Where staples with an 11 mm crown are used, shingles shall be fastened with at least 6 staples.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners may be reduced for narrower shingles in proportion to the width of the shingle or when shingles incorporating interlocking devices are used.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners referred to in Sentences (1) and (2) shall be located 25 mm to 40 mm from each end of each strip shingle with other fasteners equally spaced between them.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners referred to in Sentences (1) and (2) shall be located not less than 12 mm above the tops of the cutouts.

label: Article
text: Securing of Tabs

label: Sentence
text: Shingle tabs shall be secured by a spot of plastic cement not exceeding 25 mm diam under the centre of each tab or by interlocking devices or self-sealing strips.

label: Article
text: Hips and Ridges

label: Sentence
text: Shingles on hips and ridges shall be applied so they extend not less than 100 mm on either side of the hip or ridge, and shall be lapped not less than 150 mm.

label: Sentence
text: Shingles referred to in Sentence (1) shall be fastened with nails or staples on each side located not more than 25 mm from the edge and 25 mm above the butt of the overlying shingle.

label: Article
text: Eave Protection

label: Sentence
text: Eave protection shall conform to Subsection 9.26.5.

label: Article
text: Flashing

label: Sentence
text: Flashing shall conform to Subsection 9.26.4.

label: Subsection
text: Asphalt Shingles on Slopes of less than 1 in 3

label: Article
text: Coverage

label: Sentence
text: Except for the first 2 courses, coverage shall be not less than 3 thicknesses of shingle over the entire roof, disregarding cutouts.

label: Article
text: Starter Strip

label: Sentence
text: A starter strip shall be installed as in Article 9.26.7.2.

label: Sentence
text: Starter strips required in Sentence (1) shall be laid in a continuous band of cement not less than 200 mm wide.

label: Article
text: Securing of Tabs

label: Sentence
text: Shingle tabs shall be secured with cold application cement applied at the rate of not less than 0.5 L/m 2 of cemented area, or hot application asphalt applied at the rate of 1 kg/m 2 of cemented area.

label: Article
text: Securing of Shingle Courses

label: Sentence
text: The first course of shingles shall be secured by a continuous band of cement along the eaves applied so that the width of the band equals the shingle exposure plus 100 mm.

label: Sentence
text: The succeeding courses of shingles shall be secured by a continuous band of cement applied so that the width of the band equals the shingle exposure plus 50 mm.

label: Sentence
text: The band required in Sentence (2) shall be located not more than 50 mm above the butt of the overlying course of shingles.

label: Article
text: Hips and Ridges

label: Sentence
text: Shingles on hips and ridges shall be not less than 300 mm wide applied to provide triple coverage.

label: Sentence
text: Shingles referred to in Sentence (1) shall be cemented to the roof shingles and to each other with a coat of cement and fastened with nails or staples located 40 mm above the butt of the overlying shingle and 50 mm from each edge.

label: Article
text: Flashing

label: Sentence
text: Flashing shall conform to Subsection 9.26.4.

label: Article
text: Fastening

label: Sentence
text: Shingles shall be fastened in accordance with Article 9.26.7.4.

label: Subsection
text: Wood Roof Shingles

label: Article
text: Decking

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence 9.23.16.1.(1), decking for wood shingled roofs may be continuous or spaced.

label: Article
text: Grade

label: Sentence
text: Western cedar shingles shall be not less than No. 2 grade.

label: Sentence
text: Eastern white cedar shingles shall be not less than B (clear) grade.

label: Article
text: Size

label: Sentence
text: Wood shingles shall be not less than 400 mm long and not less than 75 mm or more than 350 mm wide.

label: Article
text: Spacing and Joints

label: Sentence
text: Shingles shall be spaced approximately 6 mm apart and offset at the joints in adjacent courses not less than 40 mm so that joints in alternate courses are staggered.

label: Article
text: Fastening

label: Sentence
text: Shingles shall be fastened with 2 nails or staples located approximately 20 mm from the sides of the shingle and 40 mm above the exposure line.

label: Article
text: Exposure

label: Sentence
text: The exposure of wood roof shingles shall conform to Table 9.26.9.6.

label: Table
title: Table 9.26.9.6.
text: Exposure of Wood Roof Shingles Forming Part of Sentence 9.26.9.6.(1) Maximum Exposure, mm No.1 or A Grade Length of Shingle, mm No. 2 or B Grade Length of Shingle, mm Roof Slope 400 450 600 400 450 600 < 1 in 3 100 115 165 90 100 140 ≥1 in 3 125 140 190 100 115 165

label: Article
text: Flashing

label: Sentence
text: Flashing shall conform to Subsection 9.26.4.

label: Article
text: Eave Protection

label: Sentence
text: Eave protection shall conform to Subsection 9.26.5.

label: Subsection
text: Cedar Roof Shakes

label: Article
text: Size and Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Shakes shall be not less than 450 mm long and not less than 100 mm nor more than 350 mm wide with a butt thickness of not more than 32 mm and not less than 9 mm.

label: Article
text: Underlay

label: Sentence
text: Where eave protection is not provided, an underlay conforming to the requirements in Article 9.26.6.1. for wood shingles shall be laid as a strip not less than 900 mm wide along the eaves.

label: Sentence
text: A strip of material similar to that described in Sentence (1) not less than 450 mm wide shall be interlaid between each course of shakes with the bottom edge of the strip positioned above the butt line at a distance equal to double the exposure of the shakes.

label: Sentence
text: Interlaid strips referred to in Sentence (2) shall be lapped not less than 150 mm at hips and ridges in a manner that will prevent water from reaching the roof sheathing.

label: Article
text: Spacing and Joints

label: Sentence
text: Shakes shall be spaced 6 mm to 9 mm apart and the joints in any one course shall be separated not less than 40 mm from joints in adjacent courses.

label: Article
text: Fastening

label: Sentence
text: Shakes shall be fastened with nails located approximately 20 mm from the sides of the shakes and 40 mm above the exposure line.

label: Article
text: Exposure

label: Sentence
text: The exposure of wood shakes shall not exceed

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 190 mm for shakes not less than 450 mm long, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 250 mm for shakes not less than 600 mm long.

label: Article
text: Flashing

label: Sentence
text: Flashing shall conform to Subsection 9.26.4.

label: Article
text: Eave Protection

label: Sentence
text: Eave protection shall conform to Subsection 9.26.5.

label: Article
text: Grade

label: Sentence
text: Shakes shall be not less than No. 1 or Handsplit grade.

label: Subsection
text: Built-Up Roofs

label: Article
text: Quantity of Materials

label: Sentence
text: The quantities of bituminous materials used on built-up roofs shall conform to Table 9.26.11.1.

label: Table
title: Table 9.26.11.1.
text: Quantities of Bitumen for Built-up Roofs Forming Part of Sentence 9.26.11.1.(1) Amount of Bitumen per Square Metre of Roof Surface Type of Roof Mopping Coats between Layers Flood Coat Asphalt and aggregate 1 kg 3 kg Coal-tar and aggregate 1.2 kg 3.6 kg Cold process roofing 0.75 L cold process cement 2 L cold process top coating

label: Article
text: Coal-Tar and Asphalt Products

label: Sentence
text: Coal-tar products and asphalt products shall not be used together in built-up roof construction.

label: Article
text: Roof Felts

label: Sentence
text: Bitumen roofing felts shall be at least No. 15 felt.

label: Article
text: Aggregate Surfacing

label: Sentence
text: Aggregate used for surfacing built-up roofs shall be clean, dry and durable and shall consist of particles of gravel, crushed stone or air-cooled blast furnace slag having a size of from 6 mm to 15 mm.

references.link_text: Furnace means a space-heating appliance using warm air as the heating medium and usually having provision for the attachment of ducts.

label: Sentence
text: The minimum amount of aggregate surfacing per square metre of roof surface shall be 15 kg gravel or crushed stone or 10 kg crushed slag.

label: Article
text: Flashing

label: Sentence
text: Flashing for built-up roofs shall conform to Subsection 9.26.4.

label: Article
text: Number of Layers

label: Sentence
text: Built-up roofing shall consist of not less than 3 mopped-down layers of roofing felt flood coated with bitumen.

label: Article
text: Installation of Layers

label: Sentence
text: In hot process applications each layer of bitumen-saturated felt shall be laid while the bitumen is hot, with each layer overlapping the previous one.

label: Sentence
text: The full width under each lap referred to in Sentence (1) shall be coated with bitumen so that in no place does felt touch felt.

label: Sentence
text: Felt shall be laid free of wrinkles and shall be rolled directly into the hot bitumen and broomed forward and outward from the centre to ensure complete adhesion.

label: Article
text: Roofing over Wood-Based Sheathing

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted in Sentence (2), built-up roofing applied over wood, plywood, OSB or waferboard roof sheathing shall be laid over an additional base layer of felt laid dry over the entire roof deck with not less than a 50 mm headlap and a 50 mm sidelap between each sheet.

label: Sentence
text: Where plywood, OSB or waferboard roof sheathing is used, the dry layer of felt required in Sentence (1) may be omitted when the joints are taped and the sheathing is primed with asphalt.

label: Article
text: Attachment to Decking

label: Sentence
text: Roofing shall be securely attached to the decking or where insulation is applied above the deck, the insulation shall be securely attached to the deck before the first layer of felt is fastened to the insulation.

label: Article
text: Cant Strips

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted in Sentence (4), a cant strip shall be provided at the edges of roofs.

label: Sentence
text: At least 2 plies of the roofing membrane shall be carried over the top of the cant strip.

label: Sentence
text: Flashing shall extend over the top of the cant strip and be shaped to form a drip.

label: Sentence
text: The cant strip required in Sentence (1) need not be provided where a gravel stop is installed at the edge of roofs.

label: Sentence
text: The roofing membranes shall be carried over the edge of the roof before the gravel stop referred to in Sentence (4) is fastened and 2 plies of roofing membrane mopped to the top surface of the gravel stop before the flood coat is applied.

label: Sentence
text: The gravel stop referred to in Sentence (4) shall extend over the edge of the roof to form a drip or shall be flashed so that the flashing extends over the edge to form a drip.

label: Subsection
text: Selvage Roofing

label: Article
text: Coverage

label: Sentence
text: Wide selvage asphalt roofing shall provide double coverage over the entire roof surface.

label: Article
text: Joints

label: Sentence
text: Plies of selvage roofing shall be cemented together to ensure a watertight joint.

label: Subsection
text: Sheet Metal Roofing

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Sheet metal roofing shall be not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 0.33 mm thick galvanized steel,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 0.46 mm thick copper,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 0.46 mm thick zinc, or

label: Clause
title: d)
text: 0.48 mm thick aluminum.

label: Article
text: Support

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence 9.23.16.1.(1), where sheet metal roofing is not supported by roof decking but spans between spaced supports, the panels shall be designed to support the specified live loads for roofs.

label: Subsection
text: Glass Reinforced Polyester Roofing

label: Article
text: Support

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence 9.23.16.1.(1), where glass-reinforced polyester roofing panels are not supported by roof decking but span between spaced supports, the panels shall be designed to support the specified live roof loads.

label: Subsection
text: Hot Applied Rubberized Asphalt Roofing

label: Article
text: Installation

label: Sentence
text: Hot applied rubberized asphalt roofing shall be installed in accordance with CAN/CGSB-37.51-M, “Application for Hot-Applied Rubberized Asphalt for Roofing and Waterproofing.”

label: Subsection
text: Polyvinyl Chloride Sheet Roofing

label: Article
text: Installation

label: Sentence
text: Polyvinyl chloride sheet applied roofing membrane shall be installed in accordance with CGSB 37-GP-55M, “Application of Sheet Applied Flexible Polyvinyl Chloride Roofing Membrane.”

label: Subsection
text: Concrete Roof Tiles

label: Article
text: Installation

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence 9.23.16.1.(1), concrete roof tiles shall be installed according to CAN/CSA-A220 Series, “Concrete Roof Tiles.” (See Note A-9.26.17.1.(1).)

label: Subsection
text: Roof Drains and Downspouts

label: Article
text: Roof Drains

label: Sentence
text: When roof drains are provided they shall conform to Part 7.

label: Article
text: Downspouts

label: Sentence
text: Where downspouts are provided and are not connected to a sewer, extensions shall be provided to carry rainwater away from the building in a manner which will prevent soil erosion.

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

Soil means that portion of the earth's crust that is fragmentary, or such that some individual particles of a dried sample may be readily separated by agitation in water; it includes boulders, cobbles, gravel, sand, silt, clay and organic matter.

label: Section
title: Section 9.27.
text: Cladding

label: Subsection
text: Application

label: Article
text: General

label: Sentence
text: Where lumber, wood shingles, shakes, fibre-cement shingles, planks and sheets, plywood, OSB, waferboard, hardboard, vinyl, insulated vinyl, polypropylene, aluminum or steel, including trim and soffits, are installed as cladding on wood-frame walls or above-ground flat insulating concrete form walls exposed to precipitation, the cladding assembly shall comply with

label: Clause
title: a)
text: Subsections 9.27.2. to 9.27.13., or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: Part 5.

label: Sentence
text: Where stucco is installed as cladding on wood-frame walls, above-ground flat insulating concrete form walls or masonry walls exposed to precipitation, the cladding assembly shall comply with

label: Clause
title: a)
text: Subsections 9.27.2. to 9.27.5., and Section 9.28., or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: Part 5.

label: Sentence
text: Where masonry serves as cladding on wood-frame walls, above-ground flat insulating concrete form walls or masonry walls exposed to precipitation, the cladding assembly shall comply with

label: Clause
title: a)
text: Subsections 9.27.2. to 9.27.4., and Section 9.20., except for masonry veneer, which shall be attached to above-ground flat insulating concrete form walls in accordance with Sentence 9.27.5.4.(2), or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: Part 5.

label: Sentence
text: Where asphalt shingles are installed as cladding on wood-frame walls exposed to precipitation, the cladding assembly shall comply with

label: Clause
title: a)
text: Subsections 9.26.7. and 9.27.2. to 9.27.4., or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: Part 5.

label: Sentence
text: Where an exterior insulation finish system is installed as cladding on wood-frame, masonry, cold-formed steel stud, above-ground flat insulating concrete form or cast-in-place concrete walls exposed to precipitation, the cladding assembly shall comply with

label: Clause
title: b)
text: Part 5.

label: Sentence
text: Where cladding materials other than those described in Sentences (1) to (5) are installed, or where the cladding materials described in Sentences (1) to (5) are installed on substrates other than those identified in Sentences (1) to (5), the materials and installation shall comply with Part 5.

label: Subsection
text: Required Protection from Precipitation

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Note A-9.27.2.)

label: Article
text: Minimizing and Preventing Ingress and Damage

label: Sentence
text: Except where exterior walls are protected from precipitation or where it can be shown that precipitation ingress will not adversely affect occupant health or safety, exterior walls shall be designed and constructed to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: minimize the ingress of precipitation into the assembly, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: prevent the ingress of precipitation into interior space.

label: Sentence
text: Except where exterior walls are protected from specific mechanisms of deterioration, such as mechanical impact and ultraviolet radiation, exterior walls shall be designed and constructed to minimize the likelihood of their required performance being reduced to an unacceptable level as a result of those mechanisms.

label: Article
text: Minimum Protection from Precipitation Ingress

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Note A-9.27.2.2.)

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), a cladding assembly is deemed to have a capillary break between the cladding and the backing assembly, where

label: Clause
title: a)
text: there is a drained and vented air space not less than 9.5 mm deep behind the cladding, over the full height and width of the wall (see also Article 9.27.5.3.),

label: Clause
title: b)
text: an open drainage material, not less than 10 mm thick and with a cross-sectional area that is not less than 80% open, is installed between the cladding and the backing, over the full height and width of the wall,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: the cladding is loosely fastened to the backing and behind each cladding component there is a clear air space that is

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: continuous for the full width of the component,

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: not less than 10 mm deep at the bottom of the component, and

label: Subclause
title: iii)
text: not less than 6 mm deep over not less than 90 mm for every 230 mm of exposed height of the component,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: the wall is a masonry cavity wall or the cladding is masonry veneer constructed according to Section 9.20., or

references.link_text: Cavity wall means a construction of masonry units laid with a cavity between the wythes. The wythes are tied together with metal ties or bonding units, and are relied on to act together in resisting lateral loads.

label: Clause
title: e)
text: the cladding conforms to Subsection 9.27.14.

label: Sentence
text: The drained and vented air space, and drainage material described in Sentence (1) may be interrupted by

label: Clause
title: a)
text: penetrations for windows, doors and services,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: flashing, and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: furring, provided the furring does not make up more than 20% of the furred area.

label: Sentence
text: Where a construction projects over the top of the drained and vented air space described in Clause (1)(a) or over the drainage material described in Clause (1)(b), the air space or drainage material shall not be contiguous with concealed spaces in the projecting construction.

label: Sentence
text: Exterior walls exposed to precipitation shall be protected against precipitation ingress by an exterior cladding assembly consisting of a first plane of protection and a second plane of protection, where such walls enclose spaces of residential occupancy or spaces that directly serve spaces of residential occupancy .

references.link_text: Residential occupancy (Group C) means the occupancy or use of a building or part thereof by persons for whom sleeping accommodation is provided but who are not harboured for the purpose of receiving care or treatment and are not involuntarily detained.

Residential occupancy (Group C) means the occupancy or use of a building or part thereof by persons for whom sleeping accommodation is provided but who are not harboured for the purpose of receiving care or treatment and are not involuntarily detained.

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (6), exterior walls exposed to precipitation shall be protected against precipitation ingress by an exterior cladding assembly consisting of a first plane of protection and a second plane of protection incorporating a capillary break, where

label: Clause
title: a)
text: the number of degree-days is less than 3400 and the moisture index is greater than 0.90, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the number of degree-days is 3400 or more, and the moisture index is greater than 1.00.

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Sentence 1.1.3.1.(1) and Appendix C for information on the moisture index.)

label: Sentence
text: In exterior walls described in Sentence (5), the first and second planes of protection need not incorporate a capillary break, where

label: Clause
title: a)
text: it can be shown that omitting the capillary break will not adversely affect the performance of the building assemblies,

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the building is an accessory building , or

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: the wall

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: is constructed of non-moisture-sensitive materials, and intersecting or supported floors are also constructed of non-moisture-sensitive materials, or

label: Clause
title: ii) is constructed as a mass wall of sufficient thickness to
text: minimize the transfer of moisture to the interior.

label: Article
text: First and Second Planes of Protection

label: Sentence
text: Where walls required to provide protection from precipitation comprise cladding assemblies with first and second planes of protection,

label: Clause
title: a)
text: the first plane of protection shall

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: consist of cladding with appropriate trim, accessory pieces and fasteners, and

label: Clause
title: ii) be designed and constructed to minimize the passage
text: of rain and snow into the wall by minimizing holes and managing precipitation ingress caused by the kinetic energy of raindrops, surface tension, capillarity, gravity, and air pressure differences (see Subsection 9.27.4.),

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the second plane of protection shall be designed and constructed to (see Subsection 9.27.3.)

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: intercept all rain and snow that gets past the first plane of protection, and

label: Clause
title: ii) effectively dissipate any rain or snow to the exterior, and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: the protection provided by the first and second planes of protection shall be maintained

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: at wall penetrations created by the installation of components and services such as windows, doors, ventilation ducts, piping, wiring and electrical outlets, and

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: at the interface with other wall assemblies.

label: Article
text: Protection of Cladding from Moisture

label: Sentence
text: A clearance of not less than 200 mm shall be provided between finished ground and cladding that is adversely affected by moisture, such as untreated wood, plywood, OSB, waferboard and hardboard.

label: Sentence
text: A clearance of not less than 50 mm shall be provided between a roof surface and cladding that is adversely affected by moisture, such as untreated wood, plywood, OSB, waferboard and hardboard.

label: Subsection
text: Second Plane of Protection

label: Article
text: Elements of the Second Plane of Protection

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Note A-9.27.3.1.)

label: Sentence
text: The second plane of protection shall consist of a drainage plane having an appropriate inner boundary and flashing to dissipate rainwater to the exterior.

label: Sentence
text: Except for cladding systems conforming to Subsection 9.27.14., the inner boundary of the drainage plane shall comply with Articles 9.27.3.2. to 9.27.3.6.

label: Sentence
text: The protection provided by the second plane of protection shall be maintained

label: Clause
title: a)
text: at wall penetrations created by the installation of components and services such as windows, doors, ventilation ducts, piping, wiring and electrical outlets, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: at the interface with other wall assemblies.

label: Sentence
text: Flashing material and its installation shall comply with Articles 9.27.3.7. and 9.27.3.8.

label: Article
text: Sheathing Membrane Material Standard

label: Sentence
text: Sheathing membranes shall conform to the performance requirements of CAN/CGSB-51.32-M, “Sheathing, Membrane, Breather Type.”

label: Article
text: Required Sheathing Membrane and Installation

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Articles 9.27.3.4. to 9.27.3.6., at least one layer of sheathing membrane shall be applied beneath cladding.

label: Sentence
text: Sheathing membrane required in Sentence (1) shall be applied so that joints are lapped not less than 100 mm.

label: Sentence
text: Where sheathing membrane required in Sentence (1) is applied horizontally, the upper sheets shall overlap the lower sheets.

label: Article
text: Insulating Sheathing in lieu of Sheathing Membrane

label: Sentence
text: Where non-wood-based rigid exterior insulating sheathing, or exterior insulating sheathing with an integral sheathing membrane is installed, a separate sheathing membrane is not required.

label: Sentence
text: Where insulating sheathing is installed as provided in Sentence (1),

label: Clause
title: a)
text: sheathing panels subject to moisture deterioration shall be sealed at all joints, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the joints of sheathing panels not subject to moisture deterioration shall be

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: sealed at all joints, or

label: Clause
title: ii) lapped or tongue and groove, and detailed to ensure
text: drainage of water to the exterior.

label: Article
text: Sheathing Membranes in lieu of Sheathing

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Article 9.27.3.6., where no sheathing is used, at least 2 layers of sheathing membrane shall be applied beneath the cladding. (See Article 9.23.17.1. and Note A-9.27.3.5.(1).)

label: Sentence
text: All joints in the sheathing membrane required in Sentence (1) shall occur over framing, and the membrane shall be fastened to the framing with roofing nails or staples spaced not more than 150 mm along the edges of the outer layer of sheathing membrane.

label: Sentence
text: Wall sheathing is permitted to be used in lieu of one layer of sheathing membrane required in Sentence (1), and its thickness need not conform to

label: Article
text: Face Sealed Cladding

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Note A-9.27.3.6.)

label: Sentence
text: Sheathing membrane is permitted to be omitted beneath cladding when the joints in the cladding are formed to effectively prevent the passage of wind and rain in conformance with Sentence (2) or (3), as applicable.

label: Sentence
text: Cladding consisting of sheets of plywood, hardboard, OSB, waferboard or fibre cement is considered to meet the requirements of Sentence (1), provided the cladding is applied so that

label: Clause
title: a)
text: all edges are directly supported by framing,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the vertical joints between adjacent sheets are sealed and

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: covered with battens,

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: shiplapped, or

label: Clause
title: iii) otherwise matched to provide weathertight joints, and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: the horizontal joints between adjacent sheets are sealed and

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: shiplapped, or

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: otherwise matched to provide weathertight joints.

label: Sentence
text: Metal siding consisting of sheets of metal is considered to meet the requirements of Sentence (1) where the joints between sheets are of the locked-seam type.

label: Article
text: Flashing Materials

label: Sentence
text: Flashing shall consist of not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 1.73 mm thick sheet lead,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 0.33 mm thick galvanized steel,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 0.46 mm thick copper,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: 0.46 mm thick zinc,

label: Clause
title: e)
text: 0.48 mm thick aluminum, or

label: Clause
title: f)
text: 1.02 mm thick vinyl.

label: Article
text: Flashing Installation

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), flashing shall be installed at

label: Clause
title: a)
text: every horizontal junction between cladding elements,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: every horizontal offset in the cladding, and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: every horizontal line where the cladding substrates change and where

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: the substrates differ sufficiently for stresses to be concentrated along that line, or

label: Clause
title: ii) the installation of the cladding on the lower substrate may
text: compromise the drainage of moisture from behind the cladding above.

label: Sentence
text: Flashing need not be installed as described in Sentence (1)

label: Clause
title: a)
text: where the upper cladding elements overlap the lower cladding elements by not less than 25 mm,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: where

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: the cladding above and below the joint is installed outboard of a drained and vented air space (see Clause 9.27.2.2.(1)(a)), and

label: Clause
title: ii) the horizontal detail is constructed so as to minimize the
text: ingress of precipitation into the air space, or

label: Clause
title: c)
text: at horizontal construction joints in stucco, where

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: the joint is finished with an expansion-contraction strip, and

label: Subclause
title: ii)
text: the cladding is installed outboard of a drained and vented air space (see Clause 9.27.2.2.(1)(a)).

label: Sentence
text: Flashing shall be installed over exterior wall openings where the vertical distance from the bottom of the eave to the top of the trim is more than one-quarter of the horizontal overhang of the eave. (See Note A-9.27.3.8.(3).)

label: Sentence
text: Flashing described in Sentences (1) and (3) shall

label: Clause
title: a)
text: extend not less than 50 mm upward inboard of the sheathing membrane or sheathing installed in lieu of the sheathing membrane (see Article 9.27.3.4.),

label: Clause
title: b)
text: have a slope of not less than 6% toward the exterior after the expected shrinkage of the building frame,

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: terminate at each end with an end-dam

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: with a height in millimetres not less than 25 mm or 1/10 the value of the 1-in-5 driving rain wind pressure in Pa, and

label: Clause
title: ii) at the height defined in Subclause (c)(i), extending to the
text: face of the adjacent cladding,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: lap not less than 10 mm vertically over the building element below, and

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Clause
title: e)
text: terminate in a drip offset not less than 5 mm outward from the outer face of the building element below.

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Sentence
text: Where the sills of windows and doors installed in exterior walls are not self-flashing, flashing shall be installed between the underside of the window or door and the wall construction below. (See Note A-9.27.3.8.(5).)

label: Subsection
text: Sealants

label: Article
text: Required Sealants

label: Sentence
text: Sealant shall be provided where required to prevent the entry of water into the structure.

label: Sentence
text: Sealant shall be provided between masonry, siding or stucco and the adjacent door and window frames or trim, including sills, unless such locations are completely protected from the entry of rain.

label: Sentence
text: Sealant shall be provided at vertical joints between different cladding materials unless the joint is suitably lapped or flashed to prevent the entry of rain. (See Articles 9.7.6.2., 9.20.13.12. and 9.28.1.5.)

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Sealants shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: a non-hardening type suitable for exterior use,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: selected for their ability to resist the effects of weathering, and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: compatible with and adhere to the substrate to which they are applied.

label: Sentence
text: Sealants shall conform to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: ASTM C834, “Standard Specification for Latex Sealants,”

label: Clause
title: b)
text: ASTM C920, “Standard Specification for Elastomeric Joint Sealants,”

label: Clause
title: c)
text: ASTM C1184, “Standard Specification for Structural Silicone Sealants,” or

label: Clause
title: d)
text: ASTM C1311, “Standard Specification for Solvent Release Sealants.”

label: Sentence
text: Backer rod shall conform to ASTM C1330, “Standard Specification for Cylindrical Sealant Backing for Use with Cold Liquid-Applied Sealants.” (See Note A-9.27.4.2.(1).)

label: Subsection
text: Attachment of Cladding

label: Article
text: Attachment

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted by Sentences (2) to (5), cladding shall be fastened to the framing members or furring members, or to blocking between the framing members.

label: Sentence
text: Vertical lumber, stucco lath or reinforcing, vertically applied vinyl siding, vertically applied insulated vinyl siding, and polypropylene siding are permitted to be attached to sheathing only where the sheathing consists of not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 14.3 mm lumber,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 12.5 mm plywood or waferboard, or

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 11 mm OSB.

label: Sentence
text: Vertically applied metal siding and wood shingles and shakes are permitted to be attached to the sheathing only where the sheathing consists of not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 14.3 mm lumber,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 7.5 mm plywood, or

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 7.5 mm OSB or waferboard.

label: Sentence
text: Where wood shingles or shakes are applied to sheathing which is not suitable for attaching the shingles or shakes, the shingles or shakes are permitted to be attached to a wood lath not less than 38 mm by 9.5 mm thick securely nailed to the framing and applied as described in Article 9.27.7.5.

label: Sentence
text: Cladding, trim and furring members are permitted to be attached to the web fastening strips of flat wall insulating concrete form units using screws in accordance with Sentence 9.27.5.4.(2).

label: Article
text: Blocking

label: Sentence
text: Blocking for the attachment of cladding shall be not less than 38 mm by 38 mm lumber securely nailed to the framing and spaced not more than 600 mm o.c.

label: Article
text: Furring

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted in Sentence 9.27.5.1.(4), furring for the attachment of cladding shall be not less than 19 mm by 38 mm lumber when applied over sheathing.

label: Sentence
text: When applied without sheathing, furring referred to in Sentence (1) shall be not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 19 mm by 64 mm lumber on supports spaced not more than 400 mm o.c., or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 19 mm by 89 mm lumber on supports spaced not more than 600 mm o.c.

label: Sentence
text: Furring referred to in Sentence (1) shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: securely fastened to the framing, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: spaced not more than 600 mm o.c.

label: Article
text: Size and Spacing of Fasteners

label: Sentence
text: Nail or staple size and spacing for the attachment of cladding and trim to wood framing, furring members or blocking shall conform to Table 9.27.5.4.-A.

Wood trim 51 — 600 Lumber siding or horizontal siding made from sheet material 51 — 600 Metal cladding 38 — 600 (nailed to framing) 400 (nailed to sheathing only) Wood shakes up to 200 mm in width 51 2 — over 200 mm in width 51 3 — Wood shingles up to 200 mm in width 32 2 — over 200 mm in width 32 3 — Vinyl and insulated vinyl siding horizontally applied 38 — 400 (2) vertically applied 38 — 300 Polypropylene siding 38 — 400 (2) Panel- or sheet-type cladding up to 7 mm thick 38 — 150 (along edges) over 7 mm thick 51 — 300 (along intermediate supports) Notes to Table 9.27.5.4.-A: (1) The minimum fastener length need not exceed the minimum fastener penetration depth required by Article 9.27.5.7. label: Sentence
text: Screw size and spacing for the attachment of cladding, trim and furring members to the web fastening strips of flat wall insulating concrete form (ICF) units shall conform to Table 9.27.5.4.-B where the 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure (HWP) is less than or equal to 0.60 kPa. (2) Wood trim (3) 3.5 400 or 450 (screwed to web fastening strip) Lumber siding or horizontal siding made from sheet material (3) 4.2 400 or 450 (screwed to web fastening strip) Metal cladding (3) 4.2 400 or 450 (screwed to web fastening strip) Vinyl cladding (3) 3.5 400 or 450 (screwed to web fastening strip) Masonry veneer (4) (3) 4.2 400 or 450 (masonry tie screwed to web fastening strip) Panel- or sheet-type cladding up to 7 mm thick (3) 3.5 150 or 200 (along edges) over 7 mm thick (3) 4.2 300 or 400 (along intermediate supports)

(two horizontal spacing options are given to accommodate the 150 and 200 mm o.c. horizontal spacing options for web fastening strips).
