(4) See also Subsection 9.20.5. for requirements on the support of masonry veneer.

label: Article
text: Fastener Materials

label: Sentence
text: Nails or staples for the attachment of cladding and wood trim shall be corrosion-resistant and shall be compatible with the cladding material.

label: Article
text: Expansion and Contraction

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners for metal cladding shall be positioned to permit expansion and contraction of the cladding.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners for vinyl siding, insulated vinyl siding and polypropylene siding shall be installed in the centre of the slots of the nail hem.

label: Article
text: Penetration of Fasteners

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Note A-9.27.5.7.)

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners for shakes and shingles shall penetrate through the nail-holding base or not less than 19 mm into the framing.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners for vinyl cladding, insulated vinyl cladding and polypropylene cladding shall penetrate through the nail-holding base or not less than 32 mm into the framing.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners for cladding other than that described in Sentences (1) and (2) shall penetrate through the nail-holding base or not less than 25 mm into the framing.

label: Subsection
text: Lumber Siding

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Lumber siding shall be sound, free of knot holes, loose knots, through checks or splits.

label: Article
text: Thickness and Width

label: Sentence
text: Drop, rustic, novelty, lapped board and vertical wood siding shall be not less than 14.3 mm thick and not more than 286 mm wide.

label: Sentence
text: Bevel siding shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: not less than 5 mm thick at the top, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: not less than

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: 12 mm thick at the butt for siding 184 mm or less in width, and

label: Clause
title: ii) 14.3 mm thick at the butt for siding wider than 184 mm.

label: Sentence
text: Bevel siding shall be not more than 286 mm wide.

label: Article
text: Joints

label: Sentence
text: Lumber siding shall prevent water from entering at the joints by the use of lapped or matched joints or by vertical wood battens.

label: Sentence
text: Siding shall overlap not less than 1 mm per 16 mm width of lumber, but not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 9.5 mm for matched siding,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 25 mm for lapped bevel siding, or

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 12 mm for vertical battens.

label: Subsection
text: Wood Shingles and Shakes

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Shingles and shakes shall conform to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: CSA O118.1, “Western Red Cedar Shakes and Shingles,” or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: CSA O118.2, “Eastern White Cedar Shingles.”

label: Sentence
text: Western cedar shakes shall be not less than No. 1 or Handsplit grade, and western cedar shingles not less than No. 2 grade, except that No. 3 grade may be used for undercoursing.

label: Sentence
text: Eastern white cedar shingles shall be at least B (clear) grade, except that C grade may be used for the lower course of double course applications.

label: Article
text: Width

label: Sentence
text: Shingles and shakes shall be not less than 65 mm or more than 350 mm wide.

label: Article
text: Fasteners

label: Sentence
text: Shingles or shakes shall be fastened with nails or staples located approximately 20 mm from each edge and not less than 25 mm above the exposure line for single-course applications, or approximately 50 mm above the butt for double-course applications.

label: Article
text: Offsetting of Joints

label: Sentence
text: In single-course application, joints in succeeding courses shall be offset not less than 40 mm so that joints in any 2 of 3 consecutive courses are staggered.

label: Sentence
text: In double-course application, joints in the outer course shall be offset from joints in the under-course by not less than 40 mm, and joints in succeeding courses shall be offset not less than 40 mm.

label: Article
text: Fastening to Lath

label: Sentence
text: When lath is used with double-course application [see Sentence 9.27.5.1.(4)], it shall be spaced according to the exposure and securely fastened to the framing.

label: Sentence
text: The butts of the under-course of the application referred to in Sentence (1) shall rest on the top edge of the lath.

label: Sentence
text: The outer course of the application referred to in Sentence (1) shall be fastened to the lath with nails of sufficient length to penetrate through the lath.

label: Sentence
text: The butts of the shingles or shakes shall be so located that they project not less than 12 mm below the bottom edge of the lath referred to in Sentence (1).

label: Sentence
text: If wood lath is not used, the butts of the under-course shingles or shakes of the application referred to in Sentence (1) shall be located 12 mm above the butts of the outer course.

label: Article
text: Exposure and Thickness

label: Sentence
text: The exposure and butt thickness of shingles and shakes shall conform to

label: Table
title: Table 9.27.7.6.
text: Exposure and Thickness of Wood Shingles and Shakes Forming Part of Sentence 9.27.7.6.(1) Maximum Exposure, mm Shake or Shingle Length, mm Single Coursing Double Coursing Minimum Butt Thickness, mm 400 190 305 10 450 216 356 11 600 292 406 13

label: Subsection
text: Plywood

label: Article
text: Material Standards

label: Sentence
text: Plywood cladding shall be exterior type conforming to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: ANSI/HPVA HP-1, “American National Standard for Hardwood and Decorative Plywood,”

label: Clause
title: b)
text: CSA O121, “Douglas fir plywood,”

label: Clause
title: c)
text: CSA O151, “Canadian softwood plywood,” or

label: Clause
title: d)
text: CSA O153, “Poplar plywood.”

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Plywood cladding shall be not less than 6 mm thick when applied directly to sheathing.

label: Sentence
text: When applied directly to framing or over furring strips, plywood cladding thickness shall conform to Table 9.27.8.2.

label: Table
title: Table 9.27.8.2.
text: Minimum Plywood Cladding Thickness Forming Part of Sentences 9.27.8.2.(2) and 9.27.10.2.(2) Minimum Thickness, mm Spacing of Supports, mm Face Grain Parallel to Supports Face Grain Right Angles to Supports 400 8 6 600 11 8

label: Sentence
text: The thickness of grooved or textured plywood cladding shall be measured at the point of least thickness.

label: Article
text: Edge Treatment

label: Sentence
text: The edges of plywood cladding shall be treated with a suitable paint or sealer.

label: Article
text: Panel Cladding

label: Sentence
text: Plywood applied in panels shall have all edges supported.

label: Sentence
text: Not less than a 2 mm gap shall be provided between panels referred to in Sentence (1).

label: Sentence
text: Vertical joints in cladding referred to in Sentence (1) shall be protected with batten strips or sealant when the plywood joints are not matched.

label: Sentence
text: Horizontal joints in cladding referred to in Sentence (1) shall be lapped not less than 25 mm or shall be suitably flashed.

label: Article
text: Lapped Strip Siding

label: Sentence
text: Plywood applied in horizontal lapped strips shall have not less than a 2 mm gap provided at the butted ends, which shall be caulked.

label: Sentence
text: The horizontal joints of siding described in Sentence (1) shall be lapped not less than 25 mm.

label: Sentence
text: Wedges shall be inserted under all vertical butt joints and at all corners when horizontal lapped plywood is applied without sheathing.

label: Subsection
text: Hardboard

label: Article
text: Material Standards

label: Sentence
text: Hardboard cladding shall conform to ANSI A135.6, “Engineered Wood Siding.”

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Hardboard cladding shall be not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 9.5 mm thick when applied over sheathing that provides continuous support or over furring or framing members not more than 400 mm o.c., or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 11.1 mm thick when applied over furring or framing members not more than 600 mm o.c.

label: Sentence
text: Where hardboard cladding is grooved, the grooves shall not extend more than 1.5 mm into the minimum required thickness. (See Note A-9.27.9.2.(2).)

label: Article
text: Panel Cladding

label: Sentence
text: Hardboard cladding applied in panels shall have all edges supported with not less than a 5 mm gap provided between sheets.

label: Sentence
text: Vertical joints in cladding described in Sentence (1) shall be protected with batten strips or sealant when the joints are not matched.

label: Sentence
text: Horizontal joints in cladding described in Sentence (1) shall be lapped not less than 25 mm or shall be suitably flashed.

label: Article
text: Lapped Strip Siding

label: Sentence
text: Hardboard applied in horizontal lapped strips shall have not less than a 5 mm gap provided at the butted ends, which shall be sealed or otherwise protected with suitable mouldings.

label: Sentence
text: The horizontal joints of siding described in Sentence (1) shall overlap not less than 1 mm per 16 mm width of siding board but not less than 9.5 mm for matched joint siding or 25 mm for lapped siding.

label: Article
text: Clearance

label: Sentence
text: Not less than 3 mm clearance shall be provided between hardboard cladding and door or window frames.

label: Subsection
text: OSB and Waferboard

label: Article
text: Material Standard

label: Sentence
text: OSB and waferboard cladding shall conform to CSA O437.0, “OSB and Waferboard.”

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: OSB conforming to O-2 grade shall be not less than 6.0 mm thick where applied directly to sheathing.

label: Sentence
text: OSB conforming to O-2 grade applied directly to framing or over furring strips shall conform to the thickness shown for plywood in Table 9.27.8.2. (See Note A-9.27.10.2.(2).)

label: Sentence
text: OSB conforming to O-1 grade and waferboard conforming to R-1 grade shall be not less than 7.9 mm thick where applied directly to sheathing.

label: Sentence
text: Where applied directly to framing or over furring strips, OSB conforming to O-1 grade and waferboard conforming to R-1 grade shall be not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 9.5 mm thick on supports spaced not more than 400 mm o.c., and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 12.7 mm thick on supports spaced not more than 600 mm o.c.

label: Article
text: Panel Cladding

label: Sentence
text: OSB and waferboard applied in panels shall have all edges supported and treated with a primer or sealer.

label: Sentence
text: Not less than a 3 mm gap shall be provided between sheets in cladding described in Sentence (1).

label: Sentence
text: Vertical joints in cladding described in Sentence (1) shall be protected with batten strips or sealant when the OSB and waferboard joints are not matched.

label: Sentence
text: Horizontal joints in cladding described in Sentence (1) shall be lapped not less than 25 mm or shall be suitably flashed.

label: Article
text: Clearance

label: Sentence
text: Not less than a 3 mm clearance shall be provided between OSB and waferboard cladding and door or window frames.

label: Subsection
text: Metal

label: Article
text: Material Standards

label: Sentence
text: Steel sheet cladding, including horizontal and vertical strip steel siding, flashing and trim accessories, shall

label: Clause
title: a)
text: have a minimum thickness of 0.33 mm, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: conform to CSSBI 23M, “Standard for Residential Steel Cladding.” (See Note A-9.27.11.1.(1).)

label: Sentence
text: Horizontal and vertical strip aluminum siding, including flashing and trim accessories, shall conform to CAN/CGSB-93.2-M, “Prefinished Aluminum Siding, Soffits, and Fascia, for Residential Use.” (See Note A-9.27.11.1.(2) and (3).)

label: Sentence
text: Aluminum sheet cladding shall conform to CAN/CGSB-93.1-M, “Sheet, Aluminum Alloy, Prefinished, Residential,” and shall have a thickness of not less than 0.58 mm, except that siding supported by backing or sheathing shall have a thickness of not less than 0.46 mm. (See Note A-9.27.11.1.(2) and (3).)

label: Subsection
text: Vinyl Siding, Insulated Vinyl Siding and Vinyl Soffits

label: Article
text: Material Standards

label: Sentence
text: Vinyl siding shall conform to ASTM D3679, “Standard Specification for Rigid Poly (Vinyl Chloride) (PVC) Siding.”

label: Sentence
text: Insulated vinyl siding shall conform to ASTM D7793, “Standard Specification for Insulated Vinyl Siding.”

label: Sentence
text: Rigid vinyl soffits shall conform to ASTM D4477, “Standard Specification for Rigid (Unplasticized) Poly(Vinyl Chloride) (PVC) Soffit.”

label: Sentence
text: Where vinyl siding, insulated vinyl siding or rigid vinyl soffits are required to have a flame-spread rating , the rating shall be determined in accordance with CAN/ULC-S102.2, “Standard Method of Test for Surface Burning Characteristics of Flooring, Floor Coverings, and Miscellaneous Materials and Assemblies.”

references.link_text: Flame-spread rating means an index or classification indicating the extent of spread-of-flame on the surface of a material or an assembly of materials as determined in a standard fire test as prescribed in this Code.

label: Article
text: Attachment

label: Sentence
text: The attachment of vinyl siding and insulated vinyl siding shall conform to the requirements in Subsection 9.27.5.

label: Subsection
text: Polypropylene Siding

label: Article
text: Material Standard

label: Sentence
text: Polypropylene siding shall conform to ASTM D7254, “Standard Specification for Polypropylene (PP) Siding.”

label: Sentence
text: Where polypropylene siding is required to have a flame-spread rating , the rating shall be determined in accordance with CAN/ULC-S102.2, “Standard Method of Test for Surface Burning Characteristics of Flooring, Floor Coverings, and Miscellaneous Materials and Assemblies.”

references.link_text: Flame-spread rating means an index or classification indicating the extent of spread-of-flame on the surface of a material or an assembly of materials as determined in a standard fire test as prescribed in this Code.

label: Article
text: Attachment

label: Sentence
text: The attachment of polypropylene siding shall conform to the requirements in Subsection 9.27.5.

label: Subsection
text: Exterior Insulation Finish Systems

label: Article
text: Application

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), this Subsection applies to exterior insulation finish systems (EIFS) that

label: Clause
title: a)
text: are covered in the scope of CAN/ULC-S716.1, “Standard for Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems (EIFS) - Materials and Systems,” and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: have a geometrically defined drainage cavity with a minimum cavity depth of 10 mm and an open area equal to not less than 13% of the area of a full-size EIFS panel.

label: Sentence
text: EIFS that are not covered by Sentence (1) shall comply with Part 5.

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: The materials used in EIFS shall conform to CAN/ULC-S716.1, “Standard for Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems (EIFS) - Materials and Systems.”

label: Sentence
text: The substrate on which the EIFS is installed shall

label: Clause
title: a)
text: be compatible with that particular system (see Note A-9.27.14.2.(2)(a)), and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: comply with the structural requirements for sheathing materials stated in Section 9.23.

label: Article
text: Design and Installation

label: Sentence
text: The design and installation of EIFS on the substrate described in Sentence 9.27.14.2.(2) shall comply with

label: Clause
title: a)
text: CAN/ULC-S716.2, “Standard for Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems (EIFS) - Installation of EIFS Components and Water Resistive Barrier,” and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: CAN/ULC-S716.3, “Standard for Exterior Insulation and Finish System (EIFS) - Design Application.”

label: Section
title: Section 9.28.
text: Stucco

label: Subsection
text: General

label: Article
text: Sheathing beneath Stucco

label: Sentence
text: Sheathing shall be provided beneath stucco applied over wood-frame walls except as permitted in Article 9.28.4.2.

label: Sentence
text: Where applied beneath stucco, sheathing shall conform to Subsection 9.23.17.

label: Article
text: Lath and Reinforcing

label: Sentence
text: Stucco lath or reinforcing shall be used to attach stucco to any substrate other than masonry.

label: Sentence
text: Stucco lath or reinforcing shall be used to attach stucco to masonry where

label: Clause
title: a)
text: the masonry is soft-burned tile or brick of less strength than the stucco, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the masonry surface is not sound, clean and sufficiently rough to provide a good key.

label: Sentence
text: Stucco applied over masonry chimneys shall be reinforced.

label: Article
text: Concrete Masonry Units

label: Sentence
text: Stucco finish shall not be applied over concrete masonry units less than one month old unless the units have been cured by the autoclave process.

label: Article
text: Clearance over Ground Level

label: Sentence
text: Stucco shall be not less than 200 mm above finished ground level except when it is applied over concrete or masonry.

label: Article
text: Flashing and Caulking

label: Sentence
text: Flashing and caulking used with stucco shall conform to Subsections 9.27.3. and 9.27.4., except that if aluminum flashing is used, it shall be separated from the stucco by an impervious membrane or coating. (See Article 9.7.6.2. for caulking around window frames.)

label: Subsection
text: Stucco Materials

label: Article
text: Portland Cement

label: Sentence
text: Portland cement shall conform to CSA A3001, “Cementitious Materials for Use in Concrete.”

label: Article
text: Aggregate

label: Sentence
text: Aggregate shall be clean, well-graded natural sand or sand manufactured from crushed stone, gravel or air-cooled blast furnace slag and shall contain no significant amounts of deleterious material.

label: Sentence
text: Aggregate grading shall conform to Table 9.28.2.2.

label: Table
title: Table 9.28.2.2.
text: Aggregate Grading for Stucco Forming Part of Sentence 9.28.2.2.(2) % Aggregate Passing Sieve Sieve Sizes, mm Maximum Minimum 4 — 100 2 — 90 1 90 60 0.5 60 45 0.25 30 10 0.125 5 —

label: Article
text: Water

label: Sentence
text: Water shall be clean and free of significant amounts of deleterious material.

label: Subsection
text: Fasteners

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners for stucco lath or reinforcing shall be corrosion-resistant and of a material other than aluminum.

label: Article
text: Nails and Staples

label: Sentence
text: Nails for stucco lath or reinforcing shall be not less than 3.2 mm diam with a head diameter of not less than 11.1 mm.

label: Sentence
text: Staples for stucco lath or reinforcing shall be not less than 1.98 mm diam or thickness.

label: Sentence
text: Staples and nails for attaching stucco lath or reinforcing to vertical surfaces shall be of sufficient length to penetrate 25 mm into framing members or to the full depth of the sheathing where the sheathing is used for attachment.

label: Sentence
text: On horizontal surfaces nails for stucco lath or reinforcing shall be not less than 38 mm long.

label: Subsection
text: Stucco Lath

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Rib lath or expanded metal stucco mesh shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: copper-alloy steel coated with rust-inhibitive paint after fabrication, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: galvanized.

label: Sentence
text: Woven or welded wire mesh shall be galvanized.

label: Article
text: No Sheathing Required

label: Sentence
text: Sheathing need not be provided beneath stucco where not less than 1.19 mm diam galvanized wire is applied horizontally to the framing at vertical intervals of not more than 150 mm, or where paper-backed welded wire metal lath is used.

label: Article
text: Stucco Lath Specifications

label: Sentence
text: Stucco lath shall conform to Table 9.28.4.3.

label: Table
title: Table 9.28.4.3.
text: Stucco Lath Forming Part of Sentence 9.28.4.3.(1) Location Type of Lath Minimum Diam of Wire, mm Maximum Mesh Opening Minimum Mass, kg/m 2 1.15 25 mm — 1.30 38 mm — Welded or woven wire 1.50 51 mm — Vertical surfaces Stucco mesh reinforcing (expanded metal) — 25.8 cm 2 0.98 9.5 mm rib lath — — 1.84 Horizontal surfaces (1) Cedar lath — — — Notes to Table 9.28.4.3.: (1) See Note A-Table 9.28.4.3.

label: Article
text: Self-Furring Devices

label: Sentence
text: Stucco lath shall be held not less than 6 mm away from the backing by means of suitable self-furring devices.

label: Article
text: Application of Stucco Lath

label: Sentence
text: Stucco lath shall be applied with the long dimension horizontal.

label: Sentence
text: Horizontal and vertical joints in stucco lath shall be lapped not less than 50 mm.

label: Sentence
text: End joints of stucco lath shall be staggered and shall occur over framing members.

label: Sentence
text: External corners of stucco lath shall be reinforced with a vertical strip of lath or reinforcing extending not less than 150 mm on both sides of the corner, or the lath or reinforcing shall extend around corners not less than 150 mm.

label: Article
text: Fastening

label: Sentence
text: Stucco lath shall be fastened in conformance with Subsection 9.27.5.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners on vertical surfaces shall be spaced not more than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 150 mm o.c. vertically and 400 mm o.c. horizontally, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 100 mm o.c. vertically and 600 mm o.c. horizontally.

label: Sentence
text: Nailing patterns other than those required in Sentence (2) are permitted to be used provided there are at least 20 fasteners per square metre of wall surface.

label: Sentence
text: Fasteners on horizontal surfaces shall be spaced not more than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 150 mm o.c. along the framing members when members are spaced not more than 400 mm o.c., and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 100 mm o.c. along members when members are spaced not more than 600 mm o.c.

label: Subsection
text: Stucco Mixes

label: Article
text: Mixes

label: Sentence
text: Stucco mixes shall conform to Table 9.28.5.1.

label: Table
title: Table 9.28.5.1.
text: Stucco Mixes Forming Part of Sentence 9.28.5.1.(1) Materials, volume Portland Cement Masonry Cement Lime Aggregate 1 — 0.25 to 1 1 1 — 3.25 to 4 parts per part of cementitious material

label: Article
text: Pigments

label: Sentence
text: Pigment if used shall consist of pure mineral oxides inert to the action of sun, lime and cement.

label: Sentence
text: Pigment shall not exceed 6% of the Portland cement by weight.

label: Article
text: Mixing

label: Sentence
text: Materials shall be thoroughly mixed before and after water is added.

label: Sentence
text: Stucco shall be applied not later than 3 h after the initial mixing.

label: Subsection
text: Stucco Application

label: Article
text: Low Temperature Conditions

label: Sentence
text: The base for stucco shall be maintained above freezing.

label: Sentence
text: Stucco shall be maintained at a temperature of not less than 10°C during application, and for not less than 48 h afterwards.

label: Article
text: Number of Coats and Total Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Stucco shall be applied with at least 2 base coats and one finish coat, providing a total thickness of not less than 15 mm, measured from the face of the lath or the face of the masonry where no lath is used.

label: Article
text: First Coat

label: Sentence
text: The first coat shall be not less than 6 mm thick, measured from the face of the lath or masonry, fully embedding the lath.

label: Sentence
text: The surface of the first coat shall be scored to provide a key with the second coat.

label: Article
text: Second Coat

label: Sentence
text: The second coat shall be not less than 6 mm thick.

label: Sentence
text: The surface of the second coat shall be lightly roughened to provide a key with the finish coat if the finish coat is other than stone dash.

label: Article
text: Finish Coat

label: Sentence
text: When the finish coat is other than stone dash, the base shall be dampened but not saturated before the finish coat is applied.

label: Sentence
text: The thickness of the finish coat shall be not less than 3 mm.

label: Sentence
text: When a stone dash finish is used, the stone shall be partially embedded in the second coat before the second coat starts to set or stiffen.

label: Section
title: Section 9.29.
text: Interior Wall and Ceiling Finishes

label: Subsection
text: General

label: Article
text: Fire Protection and Sound Control

label: Sentence
text: A wall or ceiling finish shall also conform to the appropriate requirements in Sections 9.10. and 9.11., in addition to the requirements in this Section.

label: Subsection
text: Waterproof Wall Finish

label: Article
text: Where Required

label: Sentence
text: Waterproof finish shall be provided to a height of not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 1.8 m above the floor in shower stalls,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 1.2 m above the rims of bathtubs equipped with showers, and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 400 mm above the rims of bathtubs not equipped with showers.

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Waterproof finish shall consist of ceramic, plastic or metal tile, sheet vinyl, tempered hardboard, laminated thermosetting decorative sheets or linoleum.

label: Subsection
text: Wood Furring

label: Article
text: Size and Spacing of Furring

label: Sentence
text: Wood furring for the attachment of wall and ceiling finishes shall conform to

label: Table
title: Table 9.29.3.1.
text: Size and Spacing of Furring Forming Part of Sentence 9.29.3.1.(1) Minimum Size of Furring, mm Maximum Spacing of Furring Supports Maximum Spacing of Furring, mm Continuous Supports 400 mm o.c. 600 mm o.c. 300 19 × 38 19 × 38 19 × 64 400 19 × 38 19 × 38 19 × 64 600 19 × 38 19 × 64 19 × 89

label: Article
text: Fastening

label: Sentence
text: Furring shall be fastened to the framing or to wood blocks with not less than 51 mm nails.

label: Subsection
text: Plastering

label: Article
text: Application

label: Sentence
text: Application of plaster wall and ceiling finishes, including installation of metal or gypsum lath, shall conform to CSA A82.30-M, “Interior Furring, Lathing and Gypsum Plastering.”

label: Subsection
text: Gypsum Board Finish (Taped Joints)

label: Article
text: Application

label: Sentence
text: The requirements for application of gypsum board in this Subsection apply to the single layer application of gypsum board to wood furring or framing using nails or screws.

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (3), gypsum board applications not described in this Subsection shall conform to CSA A82.31-M, “Gypsum Board Application.”

label: Sentence
text: The application of gypsum board to flat insulating concrete form (ICF) walls shall conform to ASTM C840, “Standard Specification for Application and Finishing of Gypsum Board.” (See Note A-9.29.5.1.(3).)

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Gypsum products shall conform to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: ASTM C1178/C1178M, “Standard Specification for Coated Glass Mat Water-Resistant Gypsum Backing Panel,” or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: ASTM C1396/C1396M, “Standard Specification for Gypsum Board,” except that the flame-spread rating of gypsum board shall be determined in accordance with CAN/ULC-S102, “Standard Method of Test for Surface Burning Characteristics of Building Materials and Assemblies.”

references.link_text: Flame-spread rating means an index or classification indicating the extent of spread-of-flame on the surface of a material or an assembly of materials as determined in a standard fire test as prescribed in this Code.

label: Article
text: Maximum Spacing of Supports

label: Sentence
text: Maximum spacing of supports for gypsum board applied as a single layer shall conform to Table 9.29.5.3.

label: Table
title: Table 9.29.5.3.
text: Spacing of Supports for Gypsum Board Forming Part of Sentence 9.29.5.3.(1) Maximum Spacing of Supports, mm o.c. Ceilings Thickness, mm Orientation of Board to Framing Walls Painted Finish Water-Based Texture Finish Gypsum board conforming to Sentence 9.29.5.2.(1) (except Sections 9 and 12 of ASTM C1396/C1396M) parallel — — — 9.5 perpendicular 400 400 — parallel 600 400 — 12.7 perpendicular 600 600 400 parallel 600 400 — 15.9 perpendicular 600 600 600 Gypsum ceiling board conforming to Clause 9.29.5.2.(1)(b) (only Section 12 of ASTM C1396/C1396M) parallel 600 400 — 12.7 perpendicular 600 600 600

label: Article
text: Support of Insulation

label: Sentence
text: Gypsum board supporting insulation shall be not less than 12.7 mm thick.

label: Article
text: Length of Fasteners

label: Sentence
text: The length of fasteners for gypsum board shall conform to Table 9.29.5.5., except that lesser depths of penetration are permitted for assemblies required to have a fire-resistance rating provided it can be shown, on the basis of fire tests, that such depths are adequate for the required rating.

references.link_text: Fire-resistance rating means the time in minutes or hours that a material or assembly of materials will withstand the passage of flame and the transmission of heat when exposed to fire under specified conditions of test and performance criteria, or as determined by extension or interpretation of information derived therefrom as prescribed in this Code. (See Sentence D-1.2.1.(2) of Appendix D of Division B.) Fire-retardant-treated wood means wood or a wood product that has had its surface-burning characteristics, such as flame spread, rate of fuel contribution and density of smoke developed, reduced by impregnation with fire-retardant chemicals.

label: Table
title: Table 9.29.5.5.
text: Fastener Penetration into Wood Supports Forming Part of Sentence 9.29.5.5.(1) Minimum Penetration, mm Walls Ceilings Required Fire-Resistance Rating of Assembly Nails Screws Nails Screws Not required 20 15 20 15 45 min 20 20 30 30 1 h 20 20 45 45 1.5 h 20 20 60 60

label: Article
text: Nails

label: Sentence
text: Nails for fastening gypsum board to wood supports shall conform to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: ASTM F1667, “Standard Specification for Driven Fasteners: Nails, Spikes, and Staples,” or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: CSA B111, “Wire Nails, Spikes and Staples.”

label: Article
text: Screws

label: Sentence
text: Screws for fastening gypsum board to wood supports shall conform to ASTM C1002, “Standard Specification for Steel Self-Piercing Tapping Screws for the Application of Gypsum Panel Products or Metal Plaster Bases to Wood Studs or Steel Studs.”

label: Article
text: Spacing of Nails

label: Sentence
text: For single-layer application on a ceiling, nails shall be spaced

label: Clause
title: a)
text: not more than 180 mm o.c. on ceiling supports, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: every 300 mm o.c. along ceiling supports, in pairs about 50 mm apart.

label: Sentence
text: Where the ceiling sheets are supported by the wall sheets around the perimeter of the ceiling, this support may be considered as equivalent to nailing at this location.

label: Sentence
text: Except as required by Sentence (4), for single-layer application on walls, nails shall be spaced

label: Clause
title: a)
text: not more than 200 mm o.c. on vertical wall supports, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: every 300 mm o.c. along vertical wall supports, in pairs about 50 mm apart.

label: Sentence
text: For single-layer application on walls, where gypsum board provides required bracing in braced wall panels , lateral support for studs, or fire protection, nails shall be spaced not more than 200 mm o.c. on

label: Clause
title: a)
text: vertical wall supports, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: top and bottom plates.

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Article 9.23.10.2. and Section 9.10.)

label: Sentence
text: The uppermost nails on vertical wall supports shall be not more than 200 mm below the ceiling.

label: Sentence
text: Nails shall be located not less than 10 mm from the side or edge of the board.

label: Sentence
text: Nails shall be driven so that the heads do not puncture the paper.

label: Article
text: Spacing of Screws

label: Sentence
text: For single-layer application on a ceiling, screws shall be spaced not more than 300 mm o.c. on ceiling supports.

label: Sentence
text: Where the ceiling sheets are supported by the wall sheets around the perimeter of the ceiling, this support may be considered as equivalent to screwing at this location.

label: Sentence
text: Except as required by Sentence (4), for single-layer application on walls, screws shall be spaced

label: Clause
title: a)
text: not more than 300 mm o.c. on vertical wall supports where the supports are more than 400 mm o.c., or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: not more than 400 mm o.c. on vertical wall supports where the supports are not more than 400 mm o.c.

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (5), for single-layer application on walls, where gypsum board provides required bracing in braced wall panels , lateral support for studs, or fire protection, screws shall be spaced not more than 300 mm o.c. on

label: Clause
title: a)
text: vertical wall supports, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: top and bottom plates.

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Article 9.23.10.2. and Section 9.10.)

label: Sentence
text: Where a fire-resistance rating is determined based on Table 9.10.3.1.-A, Sentence (4) need not apply for the purpose of fire protection.

references.link_text: Fire-resistance rating means the time in minutes or hours that a material or assembly of materials will withstand the passage of flame and the transmission of heat when exposed to fire under specified conditions of test and performance criteria, or as determined by extension or interpretation of information derived therefrom as prescribed in this Code. (See Sentence D-1.2.1.(2) of Appendix D of Division B.) Fire-retardant-treated wood means wood or a wood product that has had its surface-burning characteristics, such as flame spread, rate of fuel contribution and density of smoke developed, reduced by impregnation with fire-retardant chemicals.

label: Sentence
text: Screws shall be located not less than 10 mm from the edge of the board.

label: Sentence
text: Screws shall be driven so that the heads do not puncture the paper.

label: Article
text: Low Temperature Conditions

label: Sentence
text: In cold weather, heat shall be provided to maintain a temperature not below 10°C for 48 h prior to taping and finishing and maintained for not less than 48 h thereafter.

label: Subsection
text: Plywood Finish

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentences (2) and (3), the minimum thickness of plywood interior finish shall conform to Table 9.29.6.1.

label: Table
title: Table 9.29.6.1.
text: Thickness of Plywood Interior Finish Forming Part of Articles 9.29.6.1. and 9.29.6.2. Minimum Thickness, mm (1) Maximum Spacing of Supports, mm o.c. On Supports with no Horizontal Blocking On Supports with Blocking at Vertical Intervals not Exceeding 1.2 m 400 4.7 4.0 600 8.0 4.7 Notes to Table 9.29.6.1.: (1) Thickness limits shall apply to the net effective thickness (NET) of grooved, striated, textured and/or embossed panels and to the actual thickness of flat panels.

label: Sentence
text: A manufacturing tolerance of −0.4 mm may be applied to the thicknesses listed in Table 9.29.6.1.

label: Sentence
text: No minimum thickness is required where plywood is applied over continuous backing.

label: Article
text: Grooved Plywood

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted in Sentence (2), where plywood for interior finish is grooved, the grooves shall not extend through the face ply and into the plies below the face ply unless the groove is supported by framing or furring.

label: Sentence
text: If the grain of the face ply is at right angles to the supporting members, the groove is permitted to extend into plies below the face ply provided the thickness of the plywood exceeds the value shown in Table 9.29.6.1. by an amount equal to not less than the depth of penetration of the grooves into the plies below the face ply.

label: Article
text: Nails and Staples

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), nails for attaching plywood finishes shall not be less than 38 mm casing or finishing nails spaced not more than 150 mm o.c. along edge supports and 300 mm o.c. along intermediate supports, except that staples providing equivalent lateral resistance may also be used.

label: Sentence
text: Where plywood finish provides required bracing in braced wall panels , the plywood shall be fastened in accordance with the fastening requirements for sheathing stated in Sentence 9.23.3.5.(2).

label: Article
text: Edge Support

label: Sentence
text: All plywood edges shall be supported by furring, blocking or framing.

label: Subsection
text: Hardboard Finish

label: Article
text: Material Standard

label: Sentence
text: Hardboard shall conform to CAN/CGSB-11.3-M, “Hardboard.”

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Hardboard shall be not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 3 mm thick where applied over continuous backing,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 6 mm thick when applied over supports spaced not more than 400 mm o.c., and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: 9 mm thick when applied over supports spaced not more than 600 mm o.c.

label: Article
text: Nails

label: Sentence
text: Nails for fastening hardboard shall be casing or finishing nails not less than 38 mm long, spaced not more than 150 mm o.c. along edge supports and 300 mm o.c. along intermediate supports.

label: Article
text: Edge Support

label: Sentence
text: All hardboard edges shall be supported by furring, blocking or framing where the backing is not continuous.

label: Subsection
text: Insulating Fibreboard Finish

label: Article
text: Material Standard

label: Sentence
text: Insulating fibreboard shall conform to CAN/ULC-S706.1, “Standard for Wood Fibre Insulating Boards for Buildings.”

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Insulating fibreboard sheets shall be not less than 11.1 mm thick on supports not more than 400 mm o.c.

label: Sentence
text: Insulating fibreboard tile shall be not less than 12.7 mm thick on supports spaced not more than 400 mm o.c.

label: Article
text: Nails

label: Sentence
text: Nails for fastening fibreboard sheets shall be not less than 2.6 mm shank diameter casing or finishing nails of sufficient length to penetrate not less than 20 mm into the supports.

label: Sentence
text: Nails shall be spaced not more than 100 mm o.c. along edge supports and 200 mm o.c. along intermediate supports.

label: Article
text: Edge Support

label: Sentence
text: All fibreboard edges shall be supported by blocking, furring or framing.

label: Subsection
text: Particleboard, OSB or Waferboard Finish

label: Article
text: Material Standard

label: Sentence
text: Particleboard finish shall conform to ANSI A208.1, “Particleboard.”

label: Sentence
text: OSB or waferboard finish shall conform to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: CSA O325, “Construction sheathing,” or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: CSA O437.0, “OSB and Waferboard.”

label: Article
text: Minimum Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentences (2) and (3), the minimum thickness of O-2 grade OSB used as an interior finish shall conform to that shown for plywood in

label: Sentence
text: Thicknesses listed in Table 9.29.6.1. shall permit a manufacturing tolerance of −0.4 mm.

label: Sentence
text: No minimum thickness is required where O-2 grade OSB is applied over continuous backing.

label: Sentence
text: OSB conforming to O-1 grade, waferboard conforming to R-1 grade and particleboard shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: not less than 6.35 mm thick on supports not more than 400 mm o.c.,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: not less than 9.5 mm thick on supports not more than 600 mm o.c., and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: not less than 6.35 mm thick on supports not more than 600 mm o.c. in walls where blocking is provided at midwall height.

label: Sentence
text: OSB conforming to CSA O325, “Construction sheathing,” shall meet the minimum panel mark of

label: Clause
title: a)
text: W16, on supports not more than 400 mm o.c.,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: W24, on supports not more than 600 mm o.c., and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: W16, on supports not more than 600 mm o.c. where blocking is provided at mid-wall height.

label: Article
text: Nails

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), nails for fastening particleboard, OSB or waferboard shall be not less than 38 mm casing or finishing nails spaced not more than 150 mm o.c. along edge supports and 300 mm o.c. along intermediate supports.

label: Sentence
text: Where OSB or waferboard provides required bracing in braced wall panels , the OSB or waferboard shall be fastened in accordance with the fastening requirements for sheathing stated in Sentence 9.23.3.5.(2).

label: Article
text: Edge Support

label: Sentence
text: All particleboard, OSB or waferboard edges shall be supported by furring, blocking or framing.

label: Subsection
text: Wall Tile Finish

label: Article
text: Tile Application

label: Sentence
text: Ceramic tile shall be set in a mortar base or applied with an adhesive.

label: Sentence
text: Plastic tile shall be applied with an adhesive.

label: Article
text: Mortar Base

label: Sentence
text: When ceramic tile is applied to a mortar base the cementitious material shall consist of one part Portland cement to not more than one-quarter part lime by volume.

label: Sentence
text: The cementitious material described in Sentence (1) shall be mixed with not less than 3 nor more than 5 parts of aggregate per part of cementitious material by volume.

label: Sentence
text: Mortar shall be applied over metal lath or masonry.

label: Sentence
text: Ceramic tile applied to a mortar base shall be thoroughly soaked and pressed into place forcing the mortar into the joints while the tile is wet.

label: Article
text: Adhesives

label: Sentence
text: Adhesives to attach ceramic and plastic tile shall be applied to the finish coat or brown coat of plaster that has been steel-trowelled to an even surface or to gypsum board or to masonry provided the masonry has an even surface.

label: Article
text: Moisture-Resistant Backing

label: Sentence
text: Ceramic and plastic tile installed on walls around bathtubs or showers shall be applied over moisture-resistant backing.

label: Article
text: Joints between Tiles and Bathtub

label: Sentence
text: The joints between wall tiles and a bathtub shall be suitably caulked with material conforming to CAN/CGSB-19.22-M, “Mildew-Resistant Sealing Compound for Tubs and Tiles.”

label: Section
title: Section 9.30.
text: Flooring

label: Subsection
text: General

label: Article
text: Required Finished Flooring

label: Sentence
text: Finished flooring shall be provided in all residential occupancies .

label: Article
text: Water Resistance

label: Sentence
text: Where water permeable finished flooring in bathrooms, kitchens, public entrance halls and laundry areas is supported by a subfloor of a type that would be damaged by water, such flooring shall be installed over a membrane with a water permeance not exceeding 18 ng/(Pa×s×m 2 ) when tested in accordance with ASTM E96/E96M, “Standard Test Methods for Water Vapor Transmission of Materials.” (See Note A-9.30.1.2.(1).)

label: Article
text: Sleepers

label: Sentence
text: Wood sleepers supporting finished flooring over a concrete base supported on the ground shall be not less than 19 mm by 38 mm and shall be treated with a wood preservative.

label: Article
text: Finish Quality

label: Sentence
text: Finished flooring shall have a surface that is smooth, even and free from roughness or open defects.

label: Subsection
text: Panel-Type Underlay

label: Article
text: Required Underlay

label: Sentence
text: A panel-type underlay shall be provided under resilient flooring, parquet flooring, ceramic tile, felted-synthetic-fibre floor coverings or carpeting laid over lumber subflooring. (See Sentence 9.30.3.2.(1).)

label: Sentence
text: Panel-type underlay shall be provided under resilient flooring, parquet flooring, felted-synthetic-fibre floor coverings or carpeting on panel-type subflooring whose edges are unsupported. (See Article 9.23.15.3.)

label: Sentence
text: Panel-type underlay shall be provided under ceramic tile applied with adhesive.

label: Article
text: Materials and Thickness

label: Sentence
text: Panel-type underlay shall be not less than 6 mm thick and shall conform to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: ANSI A208.1, “Particleboard,”

label: Clause
title: b)
text: CAN/CGSB-11.3-M, “Hardboard,”

label: Clause
title: c)
text: ANSI/HPVA HP-1, “American National Standard for Hardwood and Decorative Plywood,”

label: Clause
title: d)
text: CSA O121, “Douglas fir plywood,”

label: Clause
title: e)
text: CSA O151, “Canadian softwood plywood,”

label: Clause
title: f)
text: CSA O153, “Poplar plywood,” or

label: Clause
title: g)
text: CSA O437.0, “OSB and Waferboard.”

label: Sentence
text: Panel-type underlay under ceramic tile applied with adhesive shall be not less than

label: Clause
title: a)
text: 6 mm thick where the supports are spaced up to 300 mm o.c., and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: 11 mm thick where the supports are spaced wider than 300 mm o.c.

label: Article
text: Fastening

label: Sentence
text: Panel-type underlay shall be fastened to the subfloor with staples, annular grooved flooring nails or spiral nails, spaced not more than 150 mm o.c. along the edges and 200 mm o.c. both ways at other locations.

label: Sentence
text: Nails for panel-type underlay shall be not less than 19 mm long for 6 mm thick underlay and 22 mm long for 7.9 mm thick underlay.

label: Sentence
text: Staples for panel-type underlay shall

label: Clause
title: a)
text: have not less than a 1.2 mm shank diameter or thickness with a 4.7 mm crown, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: be not less than

label: Subclause
title: i)
text: 22 mm long for 6 mm underlay, and

label: Clause
title: ii) 28 mm long for 7.9 mm and 9.5 mm underlay.

label: Article
text: Joints Offset

label: Sentence
text: Where panel-type underlay is required to be installed over plywood, OSB or waferboard, the joints in the underlay shall be offset not less than 200 mm from the joints in the underlying subfloor.

label: Article
text: Surface Defects

label: Sentence
text: Underlay beneath resilient or ceramic floors applied with an adhesive shall have all holes or open defects on the surface patched so that the defects will not be transmitted to the finished surface.

label: Subsection
text: Wood Strip Flooring

label: Article
text: Thickness

label: Sentence
text: The thickness of wood strip flooring shall conform to Table 9.30.3.1.

title: Table 9.30.3.1.

label: Article
text: Strip Direction and End Joints

label: Sentence
text: Wood strip flooring shall not be laid parallel to lumber subflooring unless a separate underlay is provided.

label: Sentence
text: If wood strip flooring is applied without a subfloor, it shall be laid at right angles to the joists so that the end joints are staggered and occur over supports or are end matched.

label: Sentence
text: If the flooring is end matched, it shall be laid so that no 2 adjoining strips break joints in the same space between supports and each strip bears on no fewer than 2 supports.

label: Article
text: Nailing

label: Sentence
text: When nails are used, wood strip flooring shall be toe nailed or face nailed with not less than one nail per strip at the spacings shown in Table 9.30.3.3., except that face nailed strips more than 25 mm in width shall have at least 2 nails per strip.

label: Article
text: Staples

label: Sentence
text: Staples are permitted to be used to fasten wood strip flooring not more than 7.9 mm in thickness provided the staples are not less than 29 mm long with a shank diameter of 1.19 mm and with 4.7 mm crowns.

label: Subsection
text: Parquet Flooring

label: Article
text: Adhesive

label: Sentence
text: Adhesive used to attach parquet block flooring shall be suitable for bonding wood to the applicable subfloor material.

label: Subsection
text: Resilient Flooring

label: Article
text: Materials

label: Sentence
text: Resilient flooring used on concrete slabs supported on ground shall consist of asphalt, rubber, unbacked vinyl or vinyl with an inorganic type backing.

label: Sentence
text: Flooring described in Sentence (1) shall be attached to the base with a suitable waterproof and alkali-resistant adhesive.

label: Subsection
text: Ceramic Tile

label: Article
text: Substrate

label: Sentence
text: Ceramic tile shall be set in a mortar bed or applied to a sound smooth base with a suitable adhesive.

label: Sentence
text: Panel-type subfloor to which ceramic tile is to be applied with adhesive shall have its edges supported according to Article 9.23.15.3.

label: Section
title: Section 9.31.
text: Plumbing Facilities

label: Subsection
text: Scope

label: Article
text: Application

label: Sentence
text: This Section applies to the plumbing facilities and plumbing systems within dwelling units .

label: Sentence
text: In occupancies other than dwelling units , plumbing facilities, grab bars, floor drains, and floor and wall finishes around urinals shall conform to Subsection 3.7.2.

label: SeeAlso
text: (See also Section 3.8. regarding

label: Sentence
text: Medical gas piping systems shall conform to Subsection 3.7.3.

label: Sentence
text: Systems used for service water heating shall conform to the energy efficiency requirements in Section 9.36.

label: Subsection
text: General

label: Article
text: General

label: Sentence
text: The construction, extension, alteration , renewal or repair of plumbing systems and sewage disposal systems shall conform to Part 7.

references.link_text: Alteration means a change or extension to any matter or thing or to any occupancy regulated by this Code.

label: Article
text: Corrosion Protection

label: Sentence
text: Metal pipes in contact with cinders or other corrosive material shall be protected by a heavy coating of bitumen or other corrosion protection.

label: Article
text: Grab Bars

label: Sentence
text: When provided, grab bars shall be capable of resisting a load of not less than 1.3 kN applied vertically or horizontally.

label: Article
text: Safety Glass

label: Sentence
text: Glazing used in shower and bathtub enclosures shall comply with Sentence 9.6.1.4.(6).

label: Subsection
text: Water Supply and Distribution

label: Article
text: Required Water Supply

label: Sentence
text: Every dwelling unit shall be supplied with potable water.

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Article
text: Required Connections

label: Sentence
text: Where a piped water supply is available, piping for hot and cold water shall be connected to every kitchen sink, lavatory, bathtub, shower, slop sink and laundry area.

label: Sentence
text: Piping for cold water shall be run to every water closet.

label: Subsection
text: Required Facilities

label: Article
text: Required Fixtures

label: Sentence
text: A kitchen sink, lavatory, bathtub or shower, and water closet shall be provided for every dwelling unit where a piped water supply is available.

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Article
text: Hot Water Supply

label: Sentence
text: Where a piped water supply is available a hot water supply shall be provided in every dwelling unit .

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Article
text: Floor Drains

label: Sentence
text: Where gravity drainage to a sewer, drainage ditch or dry well is possible, a floor drain shall be installed in a basement forming part of a dwelling unit .

references.link_text: Basement means a storey or storeys of a building located below the first storey .
Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Sentence
text: A floor drain shall be provided in a garbage room, incinerator room or boiler room serving more than one dwelling unit .

references.link_text: Boiler means an appliance intended to supply hot water or steam for space heating, processing or power purposes.
Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Subsection
text: Sewage Disposal

label: Article
text: Conformance

label: Sentence
text: Except as permitted by the Plumbing Code Regulation or Private Sewage Disposal Systems Regulation made pursuant to the Safety Codes Act, sewage disposal design shall conform to the requirements of Articles 9.31.5.2. and 9.31.5.3.

label: Article
text: Building Sewer

label: Sentence
text: Wastes from every plumbing fixture shall be piped to the building sewer.

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Article
text: Discharge of Sewage

label: Sentence
text: Building sewers shall discharge into a public sewage system where such system is available.

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Sentence
text: Where a public sewage system is not available, the building sewer shall discharge into a private sewage disposal system.

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Subsection
text: Service Water Heating Facilities

label: Article
text: Hot Water Supply

label: Sentence
text: Where hot water is required to be supplied in accordance with Article 9.31.4.2., equipment shall

label: Clause
title: a)
text: provide an adequate supply of hot water, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: be installed in conformance with Part 7.

label: Article
text: Equipment and Installation

label: Sentence
text: Service water heaters shall conform to the Plumbing Code Regulation made pursuant to the Safety Codes Act.

label: Sentence
text: The installation of service water heaters , including provisions for mounting, clearances and air supply, shall conform to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: the Pressure Equipment Safety Regulation made pursuant to the Safety Codes Act,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: CSA B139 Series, “Installation code for oil-burning equipment,”

label: Clause
title: c)
text: the Gas Code Regulation made pursuant to the Safety Codes Act,

label: Clause
title: d)
text: CSA B365, “Installation Code for Solid-Fuel-Burning Appliances and Equipment,” or

label: Clause
title: e)
text: the Electrical Code Regulation made pursuant to the Safety Codes Act.

label: Sentence
text: Where the building is in a location where the spectral acceleration, S a (0.2), is greater than 0.55, service water heaters shall be secured to the structure to prevent overturning. (See Note A-9.31.6.2.(3).)

references.link_text: building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Article
text: Corrosion-Resistant Coating

label: Sentence
text: Where storage tanks for service water heaters are of steel, they shall be coated with zinc, vitreous enamel (glass lined), hydraulic cement or other corrosion-resistant material.

label: Article
text: Fuel-Burning Heaters

label: Sentence
text: Fuel-burning service water heaters shall be connected to a chimney flue conforming to Section 9.21.

label: Article
text: Heating Coils

label: Sentence
text: Heating coils of service water heaters shall not be installed in a flue or in the combustion chamber of a boiler or furnace heating a building .

references.link_text: Flue means an enclosed passageway for conveying flue gases.
Boiler means an appliance intended to supply hot water or steam for space heating, processing or power purposes.
Furnace means a space-heating appliance using warm air as the heating medium and usually having provision for the attachment of ducts.

building , condominium, multiple housing unit, residential development, private educational institution or private club, the use of which is restricted entirely to the registered guests, owners, tenants, students or members, as the case may be, and their guests,

label: Section
title: Section 9.32.
text: Ventilation

label: Subsection
text: General

label: Article
text: Application

label: Sentence
text: This Section applies to the ventilation of rooms and spaces in residential occupancies .

label: Sentence
text: Ventilation of all other occupancies shall comply with Part 6.

label: Sentence
text: A storage garage for up to 4 motor vehicles that serves a residential occupancy may be considered to be part of that occupancy .

references.link_text: Storage garage means a building or part thereof intended for the storage or parking of motor vehicles and containing no provision for the repair or servicing of such vehicles. (See Note A-1.4.1.2.(1).) Storage-type service water heater means a service water heater with an integral hot water storage tank.

text: Systems used for ventilation shall conform to the energy efficiency requirements in Section 9.36.

label: Sentence
text: Where ancillary spaces described in Clause (3)(c) contain exhaust devices, these spaces shall be provided with make-up air in accordance with Article 9.32.3.8.

label: Article
text: Venting of Laundry-Drying Equipment

label: Sentence
text: Exhaust ducts or vents connected to laundry-drying equipment shall discharge directly to the outdoors.

label: Sentence
text: Exhaust ducts connected to laundry-drying equipment shall

label: Clause
title: a)
text: be independent of other exhaust ducts ,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: be accessible for cleaning,

label: Clause
title: c)
text: be constructed of a smooth corrosion-resistant material,

text: not include screens, and

text: not be secured with fasteners protruding into the duct.

text: Where collective venting of multiple installations of laundry-drying equipment is used, the ventilation system shall

label: Clause

label: Sentence
text: Where a habitable room or space is not provided with natural ventilation as described in Article 9.32.2.2. and is not mechanically cooled, the non-heating-season mechanical ventilation system shall have the capacity to exhaust indoor air from the room or space or to introduce outdoor air to that room or space at a rate of one air change per hour.

label: Sentence
text: A non-heating-season mechanical ventilation system shall be designed and installed in conformance with good practice such as that described in the ASHRAE Handbooks and Standards, the HRAI Digest, the Hydronics Institute Manuals and the SMACNA Manuals.

text: Part 6.

text: Mechanical ventilation systems complying with the balance of this Subsection shall incorporate at least the following components:

label: Article
text: Design and Installation

label: Sentence
text: Aspects of mechanical ventilation systems not specifically described in this Subsection shall be designed, constructed and installed in accordance with good practice such as that described in the ASHRAE Handbooks and Standards, the HRAI Digest, the HRAI Residential Mechanical Ventilation Manual, the Hydronics Institute Manuals and the SMACNA Manuals.

label: Sentence
text: Ventilation system equipment installed to meet the requirements of this Section shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturers' instructions and recommendations except that, where such instructions and recommendations are in conflict with the requirements of this Subsection, the requirements of this Subsection shall govern.

label: Sentence
text: Except where mounted on concrete foundations, fans and heat recovery ventilators shall be isolated from structural components by resilient mountings to minimize the transmission of noise and vibration to occupied spaces.

label: Sentence
text: Where flow-regulating dampers are required,

label: Clause
title: a)
text: they shall be adjustable and accessible without requiring the removal of fans, motors or insulating materials, or the use of specialized tools, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: a device on the outside of the duct or device in which they are installed shall indicate the position of the damper.

label: Sentence
text: Ventilation equipment shall be accessible for inspection, maintenance, repair and cleaning.

label: Sentence
text: Ventilation equipment installed in unheated spaces shall be installed so as to avoid condensation of moisture on fans and motors, in accordance with the manufacturers' instructions.

text: Principal Ventilation System

label: SeeAlso
text: (See Note A-9.32.3.3.)

label: Sentence
text: The principal ventilation system shall incorporate the following components:

label: Clause
title: a)
text: a principal ventilation fan complying with this Article, and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: provision for the introduction of outdoor air to the dwelling unit , in conformance with Article 9.32.3.4. or 9.32.3.5.

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Sentence
text: The principal ventilation fan shall be capable of operating at an exhaust capacity complying with Table 9.32.3.3., referred to hereinafter as the “normal operating exhaust capacity.” (See Note A-9.32.3.3.(2).)

title: Table 9.32.3.3.

label: Sentence
text: The requirement for a principal ventilation fan may be satisfied by a single fan, by the exhaust side of a heat recovery ventilator, or by a group of fans, provided all fans in the group are controlled simultaneously by a controller complying with Sentences (5) to (7). (See Note A-9.32.3.3.(3).)

label: Sentence
text: The components of the principal ventilation system shall be approved by their manufacturer for continuous operation.

label: Sentence
text: The principal ventilation fan shall be controlled by a manual switch located within the living area of the dwelling unit and clearly marked “VENTILATION FAN.” (See Note A-9.32.3.3.(5).)

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Sentence
text: If all controls serving the principal ventilation fan are in the “off” position, the principal ventilation system shall not operate.

label: Sentence
text: The requirement for a manual switch stated in Sentence (5) can be satisfied by a manual override incorporated in a dehumidistat or other automatic control, provided

label: Clause
title: a)
text: the automatic control is located within the living area of the dwelling unit , and

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the manual override is clearly marked “VENTILATION FAN.”

label: Sentence
text: Where the principal ventilation fan is controlled by a dehumidistat or other automatic control in addition to the manual switch required by Sentence (5), the manual switch shall be capable of activating the fan regardless of the setting of the automatic control.

label: Sentence
text: Where an exhaust air intake for the principal ventilation fan is connected directly to the return side of the duct system of a forced air heating system or other forced air distribution system, it shall be connected, where applicable, not less than 1 m upstream from the connection of the outdoor air supply duct required by Sentence 9.32.3.4.(5).

label: Sentence
text: Exhaust air intakes for principal ventilation fans located in kitchens, bathrooms and water-closet rooms shall be located in the ceiling or on the wall not less than 2 m above the floor. (See Note A-9.32.3.3.(10).)

label: Article
text: Ventilation Systems Used in Conjunction with Forced Air Heating Systems (See Note A-9.32.3.4.)

label: Sentence
text: Where outdoor air is to be introduced to the dwelling unit through a forced air heating system, the provision of outdoor air shall comply with this Article.

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Sentence
text: Where the actual normal operating exhaust capacity of the fan installed to satisfy the requirement for a principal ventilation fan exceeds the maximum outdoor airflow permitted by Table 9.32.3.4. for a mixed air temperature of 15°C or exceeds the minimum acceptable return air temperature specified by the manufacturer of the furnace , whichever is less, then either

references.link_text: Furnace means a space-heating appliance using warm air as the heating medium and usually having provision for the attachment of ducts.

label: Clause
title: a)
text: the system shall incorporate a means for tempering outdoor air introduced to the heating system ducts so that a mixed air temperature of 15°C or the minimum acceptable return air temperature specified by the manufacturer of the furnace , whichever is less, is achieved when the outdoor air is at the January 2.5% temperature and the indoor air temperature is 22°C, or

references.link_text: Furnace means a space-heating appliance using warm air as the heating medium and usually having provision for the attachment of ducts.

label: Clause
title: b)
text: this Article shall be considered to be no longer applicable and the mechanical ventilation system shall comply with either Clause 9.32.3.1.(1)(a) or with Article 9.32.3.5.

label: Sentence
text: For the purposes of Table 9.32.3.4., the furnace airflow shall be determined

references.link_text: Furnace means a space-heating appliance using warm air as the heating medium and usually having provision for the attachment of ducts.

label: Clause
title: a)
text: by operating the forced air heating system's circulation fan at the rate chosen to satisfy Clause (9)(a) when measuring the return airflow in the furnace return air plenum immediately upstream of the connection of the outdoor air supply duct required by Sentence (5) and then adding this return airflow measurement to the actual normal operating exhaust capacity of the fan installed to satisfy the requirement for a principal ventilation fan, or

references.link_text: Furnace means a space-heating appliance using warm air as the heating medium and usually having provision for the attachment of ducts.

label: Clause
title: b)
text: by using the manufacturer's rated flow for the furnace for 150 Pa static pressure and the wiring configuration necessary to achieve the flow specified in Clause (9)(a).

references.link_text: Furnace means a space-heating appliance using warm air as the heating medium and usually having provision for the attachment of ducts.

label: Sentence
text: Linear interpolation is permitted in using Table 9.32.3.4.

label: Sentence
text: An outdoor air supply duct shall be installed between the outdoors and the furnace return air plenum and shall be connected

label: Clause
title: a)
text: not less than 3 m upstream of the plenum connection to the furnace , as measured along the length of the duct, or

label: Clause
title: b)
text: through an acceptable mixing device installed in the return air plenum .

label: Sentence
text: The outdoor air supply duct required by Sentence (5) shall incorporate a flow-regulating damper.

label: Sentence
text: Where the outdoor air supply duct required by Sentence (5) is not connected to an outdoor air supply fan, it shall be connected downstream of all return branch connections.

label: Sentence
text: Where the outdoor air supply duct required by Sentence (5) is connected to an auxiliary outdoor air supply fan, the auxiliary outdoor air supply fan shall be

label: Clause
title: a)
text: approved by the manufacturer for the handling of untempered outdoor air if it will be handling untempered outdoor air,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: approved by the manufacturer for continuous operation, and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: designed to provide an outdoor air supply flow within ±10% of the actual normal operating exhaust capacity of the exhaust fan installed to satisfy the requirement for a principal ventilation fan.

label: Sentence
text: The principal ventilation fan control required by Sentence 9.32.3.3.(5) shall be wired in such a way that

label: Clause
title: a)
text: activation of the principal ventilation fan automatically activates the forced air heating system's circulation fan to provide an airflow not greater than the space-heating airflow,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: where applicable, activation of the principal ventilation fan automatically activates the auxiliary outdoor air supply fan described in Sentence (8), and

label: Clause
title: c)
text: the auxiliary outdoor air supply fan does not operate when the principal ventilation fan is not operating.

label: Sentence
text: With the principal ventilation fan operating at its normal operating exhaust capacity, the airflow in the outdoor air supply duct shall be measured and the flow-regulating damper required by Sentence (6) shall be adjusted and permanently fixed so that the airflow in the outdoor air supply duct is within ±10% of the actual normal operating exhaust capacity of the principal ventilation fan.

label: Sentence
text: The airflow measurements required by Sentences (3) and (10) shall be done using a method accurate to within ±15% of the flow rate being measured.

label: Sentence
text: All connections between the ventilation system and the heating system shall be in accordance with Articles 9.33.4.1. and 9.33.5.2.

label: Article
text: Ventilation Systems Not Used in Conjunction with Forced Air Heating Systems (See Note A-9.32.3.5.)

label: Sentence
text: Where outdoor air is to be introduced to the dwelling unit through means other than a forced air heating system, the provision of outdoor air shall comply with this Article.

references.link_text: Dwelling unit means a suite operated as a housekeeping unit, used or intended to be used by one or more persons and usually containing cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities.

label: Sentence
text: An outdoor air supply fan shall be installed with a rated capacity within ±10% of the actual normal operating exhaust capacity of the exhaust fan installed to satisfy the requirement for a principal ventilation fan.

label: Sentence
text: The principal ventilation fan control required by Sentence 9.32.3.3.(5) shall be wired in such a way that

label: Clause
title: a)
text: activation of the principal ventilation fan automatically activates the outdoor air supply fan required by Sentence (2), and

label: Clause
title: b)
text: the outdoor air supply fan does not operate when the principal ventilation fan is not operating.

label: Sentence
text: The outdoor air supply fan shall be connected to the outdoors through an outdoor air supply duct .

label: Sentence
text: The outdoor air supply duct required by Sentence (4) shall incorporate a flow-regulating damper.

label: Sentence
text: With the principal ventilation fan operating at its normal operating exhaust capacity, the airflow in the outdoor air supply duct shall be measured and the flow-regulating damper required by Sentence (5) shall be adjusted and permanently fixed so that the airflow in the outdoor air supply duct is within ±10% of the actual normal operating exhaust capacity of the principal ventilation fan.

label: Sentence
text: The airflow measurements required by Sentence (6) shall be done using a method accurate to within ±15% of the flow rate being measured.

label: Sentence
text: Except where a heat recovery ventilator is used to supply the outdoor air, the outdoor air shall be tempered to at least 12°C before being circulated to habitable spaces.

label: Sentence
text: Any tempering device installed to comply with Sentence (8) shall be installed in accordance with Articles 9.33.4.1. and 9.33.5.2.

label: Sentence
text: Except as provided in Sentence (11), outdoor air shall be distributed by a system of trunk and branch supply ducts , from the outdoor air supply fan required by Sentence (2) to

label: Clause
title: a)
text: each bedroom,

label: Clause
title: b)
text: any storey , including basements and heated crawl spaces, without a bedroom, and
